security_audit.summary: Eight findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, public data URLs, and readable multilingual text do not establish execution, exfiltration, or obfuscation. Two filesystem findings expose a predictable shared temporary file to overwrite and data tampering risks. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or malicious intent.

remediation.issue: The download writes to a predictable shared temporary path.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with mktemp -d and download inside it to prevent collisions and attacker-controlled symlink overwrites.

remediation.issue: The parser trusts the same shared temporary file without establishing its source.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the private download path directly to the parser, check download success, validate CSV headers, and remove temporary files after processing.

content.value_statement: Finding library addresses across Taiwan requires searching records for several library types. This skill filters the National Central Library public directory by location, name, and type.
actual_capabilities: Download the public library directory without an API key or account.
Decode Big5 text and parse directory records with Python CSV tools.
Filter records by county, district, library name, or library type.
Report library names, addresses, and types from directory records.
Include composite library types when filtering for public libraries.
Identify data.gov.tw dataset 8306 as the source for replacement download links.
limitations: The directory does not include holdings, borrowing availability, or opening hours.
Location filtering does not calculate distances or provide geographic nearest-library ranking.
Directory records do not guarantee public access, especially for school libraries.
Downloads require network access; the demonstrated workflow requires curl and Python, and source links or records may change.

use_cases.title: Find Local Public Libraries
use_cases.description: Filter public library records by county and district, then list names and addresses for a planned visit.

use_cases.title: Compare Library Categories
use_cases.description: Summarize directory records by region and type while distinguishing exact matches from composite categories.

use_cases.title: Prepare Library Reference Lists
use_cases.description: Find named school or university libraries and collect their directory addresses without assuming public admission.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Library
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [library name] in the Taiwan library directory. Report its name, county, district, address, and type.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: look up one named library.

prompt_templates.title: List Public Libraries
prompt_templates.prompt: List public libraries in [county] and [district]. Include composite public-library types, report addresses, and exclude school-only entries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: build a regional library list.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Counting Methods
prompt_templates.prompt: Count public libraries in [county] using exact type matches and contains matching. Explain composite categories and state the dataset retrieval date.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Checked Regional Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Download the directory into a private temporary directory. Validate download success, decode Big5, and check headers. Summarize [counties] by type, noting composite categories and limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: prepare a reproducible regional comparison.

output_examples.input: How many public libraries does the documented dataset contain?
output: The skill documents 610 exact public-library type matches in its September 19, 2026 snapshot.
Including 34 composite-type records gives 644 public-library matches.
These are documented snapshot counts, not a fresh download or a guarantee of current totals.

output_examples.input: Can this directory confirm a library has my book and is open now?
output: The directory provides library names, locations, addresses, and types.
It does not provide holdings, borrowing availability, or opening hours.
Check the selected library catalog and official website for those details.

best_practices: Use a private temporary directory and validate the download before parsing.
Decode Big5 correctly and report the retrieval date for directory-based answers.
Use contains matching for public-library categories and explain the counting method.
anti_patterns: Treating directory entries as proof of current opening hours or book availability.
Presenting school library listings as guaranteed public-access destinations.
Quoting historical counts as current results or ignoring composite library types.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The directory download is public and does not require authentication.

faq.question: Which library types are covered?
faq.answer: The documented directory covers public, school, university, specialized, and national libraries, including records with composite types.

faq.question: Can it find the closest library?
faq.answer: It can filter by county and district. It does not calculate distances or rank libraries by geographic proximity.

faq.question: Why does the CSV show unreadable characters?
faq.answer: The documented CSV uses Big5 encoding. Decode it as Big5 before parsing library names and addresses.

faq.question: Can it check holdings or opening hours?
faq.answer: No. Use the selected library catalog for holdings and its official website for opening hours.

faq.question: What should happen if the download link stops working?
faq.answer: Find the replacement source link through data.gov.tw dataset 8306, as directed by the skill.
